How btu is calculated

Estimate heating or cooling capacity in BTU per hour from room area and an adjustable load factor. The result is a screening estimate only; insulation, windows, ceiling height, climate, occupancy, and equipment efficiency can change a real load calculation substantially. A 400 ft² room at 25 BTU/h per ft² estimates 10,000 BTU/h. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. No. A Manual J or equivalent building-load assessment uses construction, climate, windows, and other inputs. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

BTU Calculator is calculated from the supplied measurement fields using the units shown.
A worked example

A 400 ft² room at 25 BTU/h per ft² estimates 10,000 BTU/h.

Frequently asked questions

Is area alone enough for HVAC sizing?

No. A Manual J or equivalent building-load assessment uses construction, climate, windows, and other inputs.

What is a BTU?

A British thermal unit is a unit of heat energy; BTU/h expresses a rate of heat transfer.
